briefing.text: News buzz is led by Information Technology (87.2, down 0.3 on the day, up 0.7 on the week, mentions -4%, sentiment 0.13; NVDA, MSFT, AMD, INTC, AVGO), with Financials up 1.5 to 82.0 (BAC, UBS, MS, JPM) and Energy up 1.3 to 80.3 (XOM, CVX). Real Estate fell on all measures: news buzz -0.9 with mentions -18% (O, CBRE, PLD). On X, Financials rose from rank 4 to 2 (buzz 91.1, mentions +15%, sentiment 0.12; PANW, TTWO, SOFI, HOOD, JPM) while Utilities slipped (buzz -1.9, mentions -28%) and Healthcare mentions fell 67% on a single ticker (MEDS). On Reddit, Communication Services mentions rose 35% (buzz 91.7, up 0.9; GOOGL, META, NFLX), Financial Services buzz gained 4.7, and IT stayed on top (94.1, sentiment -0.02; NVDA, AMD, AAPL).

ZM #1: Q3 earnings are due Nov 23 and an analyst downgrade pushed it under its 200-day average; this explains the rank, with the stock down 9.6% in 24h.
KLAR #2: analyst downgrade, a 50-day average break and a law-firm investigation notice; 5 of 6 articles negative, which fits the 12.4% drop.
WSM #3: headlines say comparable sales rose 5% yet the stock fell 15%; 42 articles in 2 days, the heaviest news flow among the top 3, so news explains the rank.
SILVER #4: only one article (a long-range price prediction); the rank comes from price and X attention, not news.
FUTU #5: Q3 earnings call highlights (4 million funded accounts); 10 positive vs 1 negative, so news is supportive and explains the attention.
TTWO #6: Grand Theft Auto VI reported over $2.3 billion in opening-day sales; 59 articles and about 493 X mentions explain the attention.
GOLD #7: headlines about a sharp gold selloff and bitcoin near $62,000; mixed tone (3 positive, 5 negative) and consistent with the 5-day decline.
BUD #8: dividend and analyst-rating pieces only; no clear catalyst, so news does not explain the rank.

ZM ranks first (score 0.972) mainly on a 3.3-sigma price move, attention 1.5x normal, X attention 1.7x and earnings on Nov 23; it jumped from rank 25. KLAR is second (0.963) on the biggest move of the three, 3.8 sigma, plus open interest 1.3 above normal and a KPI market resolving. WSM is third (0.950), new to the top list, with the strongest inputs: attention 3.3x normal, X attention 4.0x, volume 2.0 above normal and a 5.4-sigma move after a 15% fall; open interest is its one weak input.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
